_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score remains inside Hope band with stalling-to-falling leg and diverging factors acting as a coil; base rate favors HOLD until a clear breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Hope; narrative silent on phase and only described metals/oil price prints
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, F&G holds 63-70, funding near flat, CVD remains suppressed
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 63 with persistent exchange inflows and weak CVD, or momentum/CVD reclaim sharply higher pushing score out of band
